[[/Maps|Non-interactive maps]] | pic4 = [[File:Ice Floe ice ship.jpg|196px]] | pic4-text = An [[ice ship]] anchored in the southeast | ingame name=Ice Floe | game link type 0=explorable | game link num 0=094 }} The [[Ice Floe]] is a snowy and mountainous terrain through which a frozen river cuts across the northwest. The [[Mursaat]] maintain patrols throughout this area, although the southern areas are largely under the control of a large number of [[Ice Imp]]s. {{TOCright}} ==Getting there== This area is mostly optional. Getting to [[Marhan's Grotto]] is usually the reason to traverse this area. This area is easily reached by exiting [[Thunderhead Keep (outpost)|Thunderhead Keep]] to the southwest. ==Shrines== *Northeast, around the bend outside of [[Thunderhead Keep (outpost)|Thunderhead Keep]]. *Northwest, at the exit into the [[Frozen Forest]]. *South, near the exit into [[Marhan's Grotto]]. ==NPCs== ===Allies=== *{{x}} 10 (20) [[Turlo Oakenspear]] ([[collector]] for 7 [[Frigid Heart]]s) ===Foes=== [[Human]]s ([[White Mantle]]) (do not always spawn) *{{w}} 20 (26) [[White Mantle Zealot]] *{{r}} 20 (26) [[White Mantle Seeker]] *{{mo}} 20 (26) [[White Mantle Priest]] [[Imp]]s *{{e}} 22 (26) [[Ice Imp]] [[Mursaat]] *{{w}} 24 (26) [[Jade Armor]] *{{r}} 24 (26) [[Jade Bow]] *{{mo}} 24 (26) [[Mursaat Monk]] *{{n}} 24 (26) [[Mursaat Necromancer]] *{{me}} 24 (26) [[Mursaat Mesmer]] *{{e}} 24 (26) [[Mursaat Elementalist]] [[Nightmare]]s *{{mo}} 22 (26) [[Azure Shadow]] (does not always spawn; spawns with boss [[Frostbite]]) [[Plant]]s *{{r}} 24 (26) [[Pinesoul]] ====Bosses==== Imps *{{me}} 28 (30) [[Gambol Headrainer]] → [[Energy Drain]] *{{e}} 28 (30) [[Skitt Skizzle]] → [[Mind Freeze]] Mursaat (a random 2-4 of these will spawn per instance) *{{w}} 28 (30) [[Jade Armor (boss)|Jade Armor]] → [[Devastating Hammer]] *{{r}} 28 (30) [[Jade Bow (boss)|Jade Bow]] → [[Oath Shot]] *{{mo}} 28 (30) [[Mursaat Monk (boss)|Mursaat Monk]] → [[Aura of Faith]] *{{n}} 28 (30) [[Mursaat Necromancer (boss)|Mursaat Necromancer]] → [[Life Transfer]] *{{me}} 28 (30) [[Mursaat Mesmer (boss)|Mursaat Mesmer]] → [[Energy Surge]] *{{e}} 28 (30) [[Mursaat Elementalist (boss)|Mursaat Elementalist]] → [[Thunderclap]] Nightmares *{{mo}} 28 (30) [[Frostbite]] → [[Signet of Judgment]] ==Notes== {{gw2w}} *Complete exploration of this area contributes approximately 1.7% to the Tyrian [[Cartographer]] title. *{{Vanquisher|count = 207|low = 187|high = 233}} **When approaching the possible spawn point of [[Frostbite]], if it does spawn, there will be a hidden group of [[Azure Shadow]]s. **Some [[Mursaat]] groups have long patrol paths, so to find them you might need to backtrack to places you've already cleared. **There are Mursaat patrols in this area which are made up of 2 groups. When they stop patrolling they sometimes become one group. So when vanquishing it is advised to lure a group of Mursaat away while they are still patrolling. **It is not advised to attempt this vanquish if your armour is not [[infused]]. You will die from [[Spectral Agony]]. **[[Pain Inverter]] is particularly useful. **[[Ice Imp]]s have very high DPS, careful [[flag]]ging (and if using spirits, precasting) is essential. ***Sometimes two groups spawn right next to the [[Marhan's Grotto]] [[resurrection shrine]]. If you start from that outpost and [[wipe]] on them, it's possible to get in an endless wipe loop with the two imp groups camping the shrine. In this case it's best to restart from the outpost. {{Explorable areas in the Southern Shiverpeaks}} [[de:Eisscholle]]
